svg.text: Problem 2 — following a case with a reliable agent
deterministic orchestrator + LLM steps · approval enforced in code · resettable local tracker · Streamlit support agent (QBC13)

g.text: treated as DATA only — they can
never approve, call a gated tool
old value superseded, kept in history
did the user confirm the fix?
sees the exact text and changes
retry once with the SAME key
failure is never reported as success
step limits: 6 per turn · 30 per case → stop + propose escalation (still needs approval)
$5 budget guard before every call · record/replay cache · ledger
memory saved after every step → resume after crash, nothing lost
every case keyed by case_id → no facts or approvals cross cases
maintainer decisions go straight to the gate
gated tools (last 2 rows) require a valid Approval object
facts {value, quote, turn, superseded_by} · tried · unknowns
sources used · last decision · rejection notes
pending · approved · rejected · stale · executed · failed
one row per case, saved after every step (crash-safe)
tickets (status, labels, version — bumped on every change)
the ONLY place actions take effect · tracker reset
decisions · tool calls + args · errors · state changes
approvals (who, which proposal, hash) · no API keys, ever
ledger + budget guard · ~4 calls per agent turn
4 · Evaluation — same scenarios for the P2 baseline and the final agent
no duplicate · no stale / rejected execution
no cross-case leak · step budget kept
Leakage control as in Problem 1: retrieval uses before = time of the latest message; all eval issues and their duplicates excluded; gold never reaches the agent.
Plan as of Fri 9 Oct 2026 (17 Mehr) · build order: tracker + memory + tools + gate (Fri) → orchestrator + runner + CLI (Sat) → judge + test run + report (Sun) · deadline Mon 20 Mehr
